category_quality_description: Style, lint, duplication and overall code health.
category_dependencies_description: Vulnerabilities, licenses and integrity of dependencies.
category_infrastructure_description: Infrastructure as code and environment configuration.
category_custom_description: Checks defined by the project or by extensions.
capability_lint_description: Static analysis of style and common errors.
capability_secrets_description: Looks for credentials and keys in the code.
capability_secrets-history_description: Looks for credentials and keys in the commits of the Git history, not only in the current tree.
capability_pii_description: Looks for personal data in code and data.
capability_sast_description: Static security analysis of the code.
capability_licenses_description: Licenses of the dependencies and of the distributed code.
capability_architecture_description: Satisfaction of the configured architecture contracts.
capability_api-compatibility_description: Compatibility of API contracts across versions.
capability_iac_description: Misconfigurations in Terraform, Kubernetes and similar.
template_base_description: The base of any stack: declares the bridge with the quality gate and selects its subchecks. The project's tests and coverage are left for the profile to turn on.
template_dotnet_description: .NET components (csproj, fsproj, vbproj): fits the current chain of the dotnetweb flavor through the bridge, which comes from the base template. Partial support: no own integration with build, tests, coverage or Roslyn analyzers.
template_go_description: Go components (go.mod): partial support. Discovery, explicit configuration and the generic command with go test; build, vet, coverage and dependencies come later.
template_python-import-linter_descriptio: Checks the architecture of Python components with Import Linter: contracts generated from .jgates/architecture.yml or the project's native configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has architecture.yml or a .importlinter, [importlinter] in setup.cfg or [tool.importlinter] in pyproject.toml; without a contract, Import Linter is not in the plan.
template_python-pytest_description: Runs the tests and coverage with pytest in Python components. Comes in by evidence: only when the component (or the workspace) has pytest configuration (pytest.ini, conftest.py, [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml, [pytest] in tox.ini or [tool:pytest] in setup.cfg); pytest is not imposed on every Python repository, and JGates neither installs nor migrates the test framework.
template_python-typescript_description: Repositories with Python and TypeScript components: brings together the python and typescript templates, each tool in the component of its language. The boundary contracts between the components live in architecture.yml (component-boundary rule). Does not repeat the configuration of the two.
template_python_description: Python components: Ruff and the exclusion of virtual environments and caches. Secrets, dependencies, SAST and personal data come from the base template. Import Linter comes in through the python-import-linter template and pytest through python-pytest, each only when the project has its configuration.
template_rust_description: Rust components (Cargo.toml): partial support. Discovery, explicit configuration and the generic command with cargo test; clippy, coverage and dependencies come later.
template_typescript-dependency-cruiser_d: Checks the architecture of TypeScript and JavaScript components with dependency-cruiser, against the rules in .jgates/architecture.yml. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has architecture.yml; without a contract, dependency-cruiser is not in the plan.
template_typescript-eslint_description: Runs ESLint with the project's configuration in TypeScript and JavaScript components. Comes in by evidence: only when there is an eslint.config (flat config) at the root of a component or of the workspace; without it, ESLint is not in the plan.
template_typescript-vitest_description: Runs the tests and coverage with Vitest in TypeScript and JavaScript components. Comes in by evidence: only when there is a vitest.config (or a vite.config with the test block) at the root of a component or of the workspace; Vitest is not imposed on every repository, and JGates neither installs nor migrates the test framework.
template_typescript_description: TypeScript and JavaScript components: excludes installed dependencies and build and coverage outputs. Secrets, dependencies and SAST come from the base template. ESLint (typescript-eslint), dependency-cruiser (typescript-dependency-cruiser) and Vitest (typescript-vitest) each come in only when the project has its configuration. Type checking with tsc has no adapter of its own yet.
